title: Tanzanian Chicken Biryani
community: Zanzibar and coastal Tanzania — Eid celebration dish
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Chicken Biriani — chicken marinated in yogurt and Zanzibar spices, layered with saffron rice and fried onions, sealed and dum-cooked. The Eid celebration biryani of the Tanzanian coast — lighter than beef but equally magnificent.
longDesc: Chicken biriani is the Eid morning dish of Zanzibar — prepared the night before, the sealed pot is placed over coals early on Eid morning, and by the time prayers are done, the biriani is ready. The fragrance that escapes when the seal is broken is one of the most anticipated moments of the Tanzanian Islamic calendar.
ingredients: 1.2 kg chicken — pieces marinated overnight in 1 cup yogurt, 4 garlic cloves, 1 tbsp ginger, 2 tsp garam masala, 1 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt
½ tsp saffron — soaked in warm milk
steps: Cook marinated chicken in ghee until 80% done — 30—35 minutes.
Parboil rice to 70% with whole spices. Drain.
Layer: chicken, half rice, onions, cashews, raisins, remaining rice, saffron milk, ghee.
Dum cook over very low heat with diffuser for 25—30 minutes.
Break seal at the table for maximum theatre.
chefTips: Breaking the seal at the table is essential theatre.
The overnight marinade is the flavour foundation.
cookingScience: See TZA039 for biriani dum cooking science. Chicken cooks faster than beef — 80% pre-cooking prevents the dum stage from over-cooking it while ensuring full safety.
culturalNote: Chicken biriani for Eid is the Zanzibar morning — the most anticipated meal of the Islamic calendar. The breaking of the dum seal releases fragrance that has been building for 30 minutes, and for Zanzibaris, that moment is the smell of celebration itself.
